a.content: Lot 4d covers the planning, delivery, installation, commissioning and product training of two transformers including cooling systems.
a.source: Lot 4d: The scope of delivery and services for Lot 4d includes the planning, delivery, installation, commissioning and product training of two 110/22.5kV distribution transformers, including cooling systems

b.content: Lot 4c covers the planning, delivery, installation, commissioning and product training of two transformers with associated cooling systems.
b.source: Lot 4c: The scope of delivery and services for Lot 4c includes the planning, delivery, installation, commissioning and product training of two 400/110kV grid transformers with associated ONAN/ONAF cooling systems

notes: The tender's own boilerplate: the two lot scopes are the same sentence with the lot number and the transformer type swapped. Merging them would leave a buyer believing one contract covers both lots.
